s1.syndrome_frame: Cardiac mass syndrome with a mobile, smooth, oval, pedunculated mass in the left ventricle
salient_findings: Mass originating from the left ventricular lateral wall
key_facts: Denied fever, weight loss, dyspnea, or other symptoms
No active lung lesions on chest radiograph
Mass attached to the interventricular septum with focal contrast enhancement on contrast-enhanced chest computed tomography

raw.syndrome_frame: Cardiac mass syndrome with a mobile, smooth, oval, pedunculated mass in the left ventricle
salient_findings: Mass originating from the left ventricular lateral wall
key_facts: Denied fever, weight loss, dyspnea, or other symptoms
No active lung lesions on chest radiograph
Mass attached to the interventricular septum with focal contrast enhancement on contrast-enhanced chest computed tomography

differentials: Primary cardiac lymphoma of T-cell type
Intracardiac cystic tumor of the atrioventricular node
per_call: Primary cardiac lymphoma of T-cell type
Intracardiac cystic tumor of the atrioventricular node

shortlist.label: Cardiac Myxoma
shortlist.why_kept: Most common primary cardiac tumor, matches description of mobile, smooth, oval, pedunculated mass

shortlist.label: Papillary Fibroelastoma
shortlist.why_kept: Second most common primary cardiac tumor, can appear as a mobile mass

shortlist.label: Left Ventricular Thrombus
shortlist.why_kept: Possible cause of a mass in the left ventricle, especially if patient has a history of cardiac disease

shortlist.label: Hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Rare benign tumor that can occur in the heart, may appear as a mass on imaging

shortlist.label: Fibroma
shortlist.why_kept: Rare benign tumor that can occur in the heart, may appear as a mass on imaging

raw.rationale: The mass is described as a mobile, smooth, oval, pedunculated mass, which is consistent with the typical appearance of a cardiac myxoma, and the location and attachment to the interventricular septum also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Papillary Fibroelastoma
rejected.why: Less common and typically smaller than the described mass

rejected.label: Left Ventricular Thrombus
rejected.why: Unlikely given the patient's lack of symptoms and normal blood work

rejected.label: Hemangioma
rejected.why: Not typically found in the left ventricle and would have different imaging characteristics

rejected.label: Fibroma
rejected.why: Usually occurs in younger patients and is often associated with other cardiac abnormalities
